newsitem.title: USA: Fairchild stake held by Cramer group.
newsitem.headline: Fairchild stake held by Cramer group.

text.p: A group led by New York investor J.J. Cramer said Thursday it holds a 6.4 percent stake in Fairchild Corp, or 880,800 Class A common shares.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said its latest transactions included the purchase of 444,100 shares between December 6 and February 14 at prices ranging from $14.50 to $16.375 per share.
The group holds the stake for investment purposes.
Fairchild, based in Chantilly, Va., manufactures industrial mechanical components and systems.
